correctness.rationale: For a pure degree ell scalar spherical-harmonic space, the diagonal squared intensities F_m(z²)=(2ell+1)/(4pi)*(ell-m)!/(ell+m)!*(1-u)^m[P_ell^(m)(sqrt u)]² are degree<=ell polynomials in u=z². Their respective exact zero order m at u=1 makes F_0,...,F_ell a basis of P_ell. Summing positive tight-frame diagonals and the spherical addition theorem forces a positive quadrature exact through ell for measure dnu=du/(2sqrt u), so a rule with s distinct squared heights cannot have 2s<=ell (nonzero squared node polynomial has positive integral and zero node sum). Gaussian Jacobi r=ceil((ell+1)/2) nodes give equality, and 2ell+1 uniform longitudes cancel all different m. At the minimal r, orthogonality of monic node polynomial forces unique pi_r for odd ell, or pi_r+c pi_(r-1) for even ell, with explicitly computed endpoint-root c interval; Lagrange-squared exactness ensures weights positive. Independently checked the r=2 Jacobi endpoints and ell=2 equal-weight example; inspected check_ring_sampling.py and full RESULT.md. Finite sample Gram tests in script do not substitute for all-ell proof.
